title: AI Product Management: From Fundamentals to Shipping AI Products
description: A hands-on, project-based course that prepares you to lead AI and LLM-powered products end to end. You'll build AI literacy, master LLM capabilities and limits, craft product strategy and roadmaps, design evaluation frameworks and prompts, manage cross-functional stakeholders, and define metrics that prove impact. By the end, you'll have a portfolio-ready AI product spec, roadmap, eval suite, and launch plan.
audience: Aspiring and transitioning product managers, technical PMs, founders, and analysts who want to lead AI/LLM products and need practical, portfolio-building experience to land an AI Product Manager role.

moduleTitles.1: AI Literacy and LLM Foundations for PMs
moduleTitles.3: Building, Evaluating, and Prompting AI Features
